description: Subtitle alignment utilities for correcting and synchronizing subtitle entries using Whisper transcriptions. It includes functions to normalize timings, match subtitles to transcript segments, refit times, merge blanks, and perform holistic alignment with timing and text adjustments.

methods.name: bool _is_blank(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if a given text is None or only whitespace.

methods.name: str _normalize_space(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes spacing in text by collapsing multiple spaces and trimming.

methods.name: float _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the overlap duration between two time intervals.

methods.name: float _interval_center(iv: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the center point of a time interval.

methods.name: Any _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)
methods.description: Safely retrieves a value from a transcript segment, handling different data structures.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_seg_dict(seg: Any)
methods.description: Converts a transcript segment to a standardized dict with start, end, and text.

methods.name: None _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02, min_duration: float = 0.3)
methods.description: Ensures caption timings are monotonic and non-overlapping, enforcing minimal gaps and durations.

methods.name: Optional[int] _match_transcript_segment( sub_iv: Tuple[float, float], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Finds the index of the best matching transcript segment for a subtitle interval based on overlap and proximity.

methods.name: Optional[int] _closest_transcript_index_by_time(point: float, transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Finds the index of the transcript segment whose center is closest to a given point in time.

methods.name: List[Dict] _merge_adjacent_blanks(subs: List[Dict])
methods.description: Merges consecutive blank-text subtitles into a single segment to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None _apply_text_from_transcript(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Updates subtitle text from transcript segment if missing or to normalize spacing, with debug output.

methods.name: None _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict, *, min_dur: float = 0.5)
methods.description: Refines subtitle start/end times to better fit a transcript segment while preserving relative timing.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, cross_lingual: bool = False, preserve_subtitle_text: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Main function for aligning and correcting subtitles using a transcript, adjusting timings and optionally texts, with extensive heuristics and normalization.

ctags.name: _ensure_monotonic
ctags.pattern: /^def _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02, min_duration: float = 0.3) -> Non/

ctags.name: _get_seg_value
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:$/
ctags.signature: (seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)

ctags.name: _overlap
ctags.pattern: /^def _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:$/

ctags.name: _refit_times_to_segment
ctags.pattern: /^def _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict, *, min_dur: float = 0.5) -> None:$/

ctags.name: align_subtitles
ctags.signature: ( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, cross_lingual: bool = False, preserve_subtitle_text: Optional[bool] = None, )
